subject.title: fix(signal): add retry logic for session initialization conflict

question: Which Signal retry candidate should remain canonical after the retry semantics and proof blockers are addressed?
rationale: Multiple open external PRs target the same Signal message-loss bug, and this branch still has correctness and proof blockers, so automation should not choose or merge a duplicate retry path.

options.title: Consolidate On The Cleanest Candidate
options.body: Prefer the candidate that fixes root-error detection, bounded attempt state, delivery ordering, production tests, and live Signal proof with the smallest maintainable diff.

options.title: Ask This PR To Repair
options.body: Keep this PR as a candidate only if the author fixes the retry logic, rebases the conflict, adds production-handler tests, and provides live Signal proof.

options.title: Close After Replacement Lands
options.body: Leave this PR open until a better candidate merges, then close it as superseded by the canonical merged implementation.

recommendation.title: Consolidate On The Cleanest Candidate
recommendation.body: Prefer the candidate that fixes root-error detection, bounded attempt state, delivery ordering, production tests, and live Signal proof with the smallest maintainable diff.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal from the merged Slack retry precedent and recent Signal/channel commits.
